subject: general
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) of the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

45 × 3 + 9 − 18 ÷ 1 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given equation: 45 × 3 + 9 − 18 ÷ 1 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged:

45 × 3 + 9 − 18 ÷ 1 = ? ⇒ 45 ÷ 3 −</s
